## Activity

During June 2025, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 462 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and reflects the volume submitted for image review and grading. The capture count is presented as recorded by the site, without adjustment or interpretation.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 25 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 5.4 of all captures. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from the images that proceeded through the grading process. The result indicates the proportion of activity affected by image quality limitations during June 2025.

## Grading

A total of 141 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. This is the midpoint measure for the time between image submission and completion of grading for the reporting period. Referable results are reported as the recorded grading outcome for Harbour Eye Clinic and should be considered alongside the overall capture activity and the image quality findings.

Together, these measures summarise site activity, image usability and grading outcomes for June 2025.
